name: Ballad Tremolo
description: The instrument's own tremolo at its usual rate, soft felt, played softly through its speakers.

name: Barking Stage
description: Reeds close to the pickup and hard felt: soft keys round, hard keys growl.

name: Distant Felt
description: Soft, short and wobbling: a worn instrument in the next room.

name: Even Touch
description: Every strike at the same level; the bite still follows the touch.

name: Fast Throb
description: A deep, quick tremolo, as from a speeded-up oscillator.

name: Felt Soft
description: Mellow and even: soft felt, the reeds far from the pickup, the tone down.

name: Glassy Top
description: The tone at its top over firm felt: a glassy, ringing upper end.

name: Gritty Line
description: The line out with the pickup at its nearest and hard felt, for an amplifier to push.

name: Hard Hammers
description: The hardest felt: every key bites, even played softly.

name: Init
description: The instrument as it comes: its own speakers, the tremolo off, the voicing at its default.

name: Knocky Keys
description: The keys' thump turned up under soft felt: the mechanism heard.

name: Line Out Dry
description: The preamp's line out with no key noise and softer felt, round, for an amplifier or effects after it.

name: Long Ring
description: Reeds that ring long and soft dampers, for held chords.

name: Muted Line
description: The line out with the darkest felt and tone: a muffled, close sound.

name: Pop Bark
description: Near pickup, firm felt and a light, quick tremolo: the pop record sound.

name: Short Plucks
description: Reeds that die quickly and dampers that bite: short, percussive notes.

name: Slow Wobble
description: A slow, deep swell of the tremolo under dark felt.

name: Wide Dynamics
description: Velocity's reach at its widest: a whisper to a shout.
